Reason: They treated “apples” as the object and “I” as the subject, yielding “Maktay Zapple Mato.” But with “Maktay” meaning “is pleasing to,” the experiencer (“me”) should be the object (Mato), and “apples” the subject (Apple). The correct V-O-S order is “Maktay Mato Apple.” They also used the accusative “Mato” as if it were the subject, compounding the error.
